title: Explainable Recommendation Object
description: A confidence-scored, explainable Next Best Action produced by the decision engine and gated by human-in-the-loop approval.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run that produced this recommendation.

account_id.description: Identifier of the account or entity the recommendation targets.

domain.description: Domain pack key this recommendation was generated under (for example customer_success).

key.description: Stable action key from the domain pack action catalog.

description.description: What the action entails and how to execute it.

rationale.description: Natural language explanation of why this action is recommended.

evidence.description: Grounding evidence that supports the rationale.

claim.description: The specific claim this evidence supports.

source_id.description: Identifier of the source document or record.

source_type.description: Type of source (for example crm_note, support_ticket, usage_metric).

snippet.description: Exact excerpt from the source backing the claim.

start.description: Start character offset of the snippet within the source.

end.description: End character offset of the snippet within the source.

supporting.description: Signal keys that support the recommendation.

contradicting.description: Signal keys that weigh against the recommendation.

method.description: How the score was computed (for example llm_self_consistency, ensemble_vote).

label.description: Human-readable confidence band (for example low, medium, high).

type.description: Whether the recommendation addresses a risk or an opportunity.

summary.description: Short summary of the risk or opportunity.

counterfactual.description: What is likely to happen if no action is taken.

kpi.description: The KPI this action is expected to move (for example NRR, churn_rate).

direction.description: Expected direction of movement for the KPI.

estimate.description: Estimated magnitude of impact (for example +3 points over 90 days).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the recommendation after human review.

created_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the recommendation was created.
